obfuscation_indicators: based on various judgments and assumptions
risk_summary: The excerpt is generally quantitatively detailed and presents a strongly improved 2016 operating performance, driven largely by higher OSB pricing. Key risks include cyclical housing demand, commodity-price and supply volatility, indefinitely curtailed capacity, and significant uncertainty in legal and environmental contingency estimates. Forward-looking projections and reliance on management assumptions temper the otherwise positive tone.
